paragraphs: A son of Kimchit and a High Priest. In [Yoma 47a](https://www.sefaria.org/Yoma.47a.11)
they say: once Yishmael ben Kimchit, the High Priest, became ritually impure. His brother Yeshevav entered and served in his place, and their mother saw two High Priests in one day.[^1][^2]

notes.text: [Heilprin’s Yeshevav notice](https://www.girsology.com/seder-hadorot.html?entry=2250&lang=en) refers to [his entry on Yishmael ben Kimchit](https://www.girsology.com/seder-hadorot.html?entry=2261&lang=en), which lists Yeshevav and Yosef as different brothers.
Yeshevav substitutes for Yishmael in the linked episode. In [the next episode](https://www.sefaria.org/Yoma.47a.12), Yosef substitutes for him on another occasion.
